valid_fixes: Restore RequestStateMapping filter eventName to INSERT
Restore AcceptStateMapping filter to MODIFY with NewImage.state=Friends and OldImage.state=Pending
invalid_patches: Removing all FilterCriteria (causes each handler to process all events)
Swapping handler function references instead of filter patterns
optimal_diagnostic_path: Send a friend request; observe no pending record for recipient; check RequestStateMapping FilterCriteria; observe eventName=MODIFY (initial row write is INSERT); check AcceptStateMapping FilterCriteria; observe INSERT/Requested (accept event is MODIFY/Friends); correct both patterns.
observability_check: functional_test assertion 'pending_record_created' fails; functional_test assertion 'accept_creates_friends_state' fails
observable_symptom: Friend requests are stored but recipients never see a Pending record. Accepting a friendship has no effect. The stream-driven state handlers are wired with swapped event-type filters, so each handler listens for the wrong DynamoDB event type.
root_cause: RequestStateMapping filter specifies eventName=MODIFY but new friend requests produce INSERT events — the handler never fires. AcceptStateMapping filter specifies eventName=INSERT with state=Requested instead of MODIFY with NewImage.state=Friends and OldImage.state=Pending — accepts are never delivered to the accept handler.
